# The C API Reference

<DoxygenPage version="1.13.2">

µTest++ C API Topics (note: not available). <Link to="#details">More...</Link>

## Description {#details}

Whilst µTest++ can be used to test C code without difficulty, its implementation relies extensively on modern C++ features that cannot be reproduced in C.

As a result, there are no C equivalents for the C++ definitions provided by µTest++.
